notes.title: Windowed Mode and Other Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a menu option to support windowed mode.
[*]The escape key can now go back to the menu and exit the game.
[*]Fixed a font display bug.
[*]The right arrow now works correctly when moving onto it.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added a menu option to support windowed mode.
The escape key can now go back to the menu and exit the game.

tags.bug: The right arrow now works correctly when moving onto it.

notes.title: Keyboard Support Added + Volume Bug Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added keyboard controls for movement.  Use either the arrow keys or WASD to move.
[*]Fixed bug with very low music volume not working.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added keyboard controls for movement.  Use either the arrow keys or WASD to move.

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug with very low music volume not working.
